title: 216 - DuckTales
method: claude-code: written from the transcript, links verified by script

items.name: DuckTales
items.description: The episode's game, a Capcom platformer starring Scrooge McDuck collecting treasure around the world.

items.name: DuckTales
items.description: The Disney animated series the game is based on.

items.name: Scrooge McDuck
items.description: The wealthy duck you play, who travels the world hunting for five treasures.

items.name: Uncle Scrooge
items.description: Dell comics starring Scrooge that one host collected from the 1960s.

links.label: Wikipedia: Uncle Scrooge
links.note: Disney character and uncle of Donald Duck

items.name: A Christmas Carol
items.description: The Dickens story that inspired Scrooge's name and his change from miser to adventurer.

items.name: Huey, Dewey, and Louie
items.description: Scrooge's nephews, who appear in the game as helpers rather than playable characters.

items.name: Kingdom Hearts
items.description: Where one host knew the nephews from, and later Scrooge, in Kingdom Hearts II.

items.name: Final Fantasy VII
items.description: One host's pick for a favorite soundtrack, especially its hip hop remixes.

items.name: Hotline Miami
items.description: Its soundtrack introduced one host to synthwave.

items.name: Synthwave
items.description: The retro electronic music genre one host discovered through Hotline Miami.

items.name: Nobuo Uematsu
items.description: The Final Fantasy composer praised for his soundtracks and projects outside games.

items.name: Final Fantasy VIII
items.description: Another Uematsu soundtrack one host loves.

items.name: Ori and the Blind Forest
items.description: A game whose soundtrack one host loves without having played it.

links.label: Wikipedia: Ori and the Blind Forest

items.name: Ratchet & Clank
items.description: One host's pick for an underrated soundtrack, orchestral with techno and funk touches.

items.name: David Bergeaud
items.description: The composer of the original Ratchet & Clank soundtrack.

items.name: The Black Mages
items.description: Nobuo Uematsu's rock band that plays Final Fantasy music.

links.label: Wikipedia: Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes

items.name: Silent Hill

items.description: The composer behind the Silent Hill soundtracks.

items.name: Capcom
items.description: The game's developer, which brought over much of the Mega Man team.

items.name: Mega Man
